_note: The size chart of the supplier xingkong-sports (Yupoo) for its fan-version NBA shorts, transcribed from its album "NBA 热压球迷版球裤尺码表" on 2026-09-27. The shorts in the store come from this supplier (catalog/sources/xingkong-sports/shorts.json), so they all use it. Measurements are of the garment in cm; the supplier's weights are in jin (斤, half a kilogram) and are converted here to kg. The supplier says the data is for reference and hand measuring can differ by 1-2 cm. We sell S-XL; XXL is listed for reference only. The waist is the relaxed elastic waist and is kept for reference, not shown (the theme's table has no waist column).
